title: A Simple Trigonometric Classification of Quintic Roots
summary: This article provides a simple trigonometric method for determining how many roots of a quintic equation are real and how many are complex, without solving the equation. The approach transforms a depressed quintic $t^5 + mt^3 + nt^2 + pt + q = 0$ with $m < 0$ into the trigonometric equation $f(θ) = α\cos^2\!θ+ β\cosθ+ \cos 5θ+ γ= 0$ via the Chebyshev identity $16\cos^5\!θ- 20\cos^3\!θ+ 5\cosθ= \cos 5θ$.
